name: Foo Fighters
lyricQuotes: Hello / I've waited here for you / Everlong
Is someone getting the best, the best, the best, the best of you?

shortBio.en: Grohl-fronted alt-rock, 1994–. Drummer-to-frontman path after Nirvana; Everlong is a core Colour and the Shape reference.
shortBio.zh: Grohl 领衔的 alt-rock，1994 年至今。Nirvana 之后鼓手转主唱；《Everlong》是《The Colour and the Shape》的核心参照。

body.en:
Foo Fighters began in 1994 with Grohl playing most instruments on the debut. Nate Mendel, Pat Smear, and later Taylor Hawkins stabilized the live band. The Colour and the Shape (1997) fixed quiet-loud radio hooks such as Everlong.

Graph links: Nirvana drummer → Foo Fighters frontman → Them Crooked Vultures. Musical constants are compressed guitars, stacked choruses, and long touring schedules.
body.zh:
Foo Fighters 始于 1994 年，首专大半乐器由 Grohl 亲自演奏。Nate Mendel、Pat Smear 与后来的 Taylor Hawkins 稳定现场编制。《The Colour and the Shape》（1997）定型《Everlong》一类强弱电台钩子。

图谱关联：Nirvana 鼓手 → Foo Fighters 主唱 → Them Crooked Vultures。音乐常量是压缩吉他、堆叠副歌与长期巡演。

whyMatters.en: Dave Grohl’s post-Nirvana band, formed in 1994. From the self-titled debut (1995) a one-man demo project became a long-running alternative/hard-rock touring act.
whyMatters.zh: Dave Grohl 在 Nirvana 之后的乐队，1994 年成立。自同名专辑（1995）起，一人 demo 项目成为长期的 alternative/hard-rock 巡演编制。

note.en: Debut-cycle single; melodic verse, distorted chorus; one-man demo origins.
note.zh: 首专周期单曲；旋律主歌、失真副歌；一人 demo 起源。

note.en: From The Colour and the Shape; quiet-loud dynamic and open-chord arpeggio.
note.zh: 出自《The Colour and the Shape》；强弱动态与开放和弦琶音。

note.en: Delayed-entry riff and stacked gang vocals; late-2000s stadium single.
note.zh: 延迟进入的 riff 与堆叠齐唱；2000 年代末体育场单曲。

title.zh: 从一人 demo 到乐队

body.en:
After Nirvana ended, Grohl recorded the Foo Fighters debut alone in Seattle. This Is a Call and Big Me place melodic hooks over punk-adjacent energy.

Pat Smear (ex-Nirvana touring guitar) and Nate Mendel (Sunny Day Real Estate) joined for touring. Grohl still wrote and often recorded core tracks himself.

Foo Fighters (1995) sets the early pattern: verse melody, chorus distortion, without grunge costume.
body.zh:
Nirvana 结束后，Grohl 独自在西雅图录制 Foo Fighters 首专。《This Is a Call》与《Big Me》在朋克邻近能量上挂旋律钩子。

Pat Smear（Nirvana 巡演吉他）与 Nate Mendel（Sunny Day Real Estate）加入巡演。Grohl 仍自写并常自录核心轨。

《Foo Fighters》（1995）确立早期写法：主歌旋律、副歌失真，不做法兰绒时期外观。

body.en:
Taylor Hawkins replaced William Goldsmith on drums mid-sessions. Everlong, Monkey Wrench, and My Hero define the quiet-loud FM face of the album.

Grohl and producer Gil Norton push guitar layering; Mendel’s bass locks to Hawkins’ open hi-hat groove.

Multi-million sales fixed Grohl as a frontman, not only as Nirvana’s drummer.
body.zh:
Taylor Hawkins 在录音中途接替 William Goldsmith 打鼓。《Everlong》《Monkey Wrench》《My Hero》定义专辑的强弱 FM 面孔。

Grohl 与制作人 Gil Norton 推进吉他叠轨；Mendel 贝斯咬住 Hawkins 的开放 hi-hat groove。

数百万销量把 Grohl 固定为主唱身份，而不仅是 Nirvana 鼓手。

title.zh: 体育场年份与支线项目

body.en:
Chris Shiflett joined in 1999. There Is Nothing Left to Lose through Echoes, Silence, Patience & Grace keep radio-rock scale. Grohl also produced Queens of the Stone Age records and drummed on Songs for the Deaf (2002).

Them Crooked Vultures (2009) with Josh Homme and John Paul Jones is the main side-project node.

Best of You and The Pretender show arena draw two decades after Nirvana.
body.zh:
Chris Shiflett 于 1999 年加入。《There Is Nothing Left to Lose》至《Echoes, Silence, Patience & Grace》维持电台摇滚体量。Grohl 也参与 Queens of the Stone Age 唱片制作，并为《Songs for the Deaf》（2002）打鼓。

与 Josh Homme、John Paul Jones 的 Them Crooked Vultures（2009）是主要支线节点。

《Best of You》与《The Pretender》显示 Nirvana 后二十年仍有体育场号召力。

interviewQuotes.text: I started the Foos to keep playing after Nirvana. It became a real band.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Dave Grohl

interviewQuotes.text: Taylor made the band swing harder live than the records suggested.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Nate Mendel

note.en: Hawkins drums + Smear/Shiflett guitars; arena alt-rock core.
note.zh: Hawkins 鼓 + Smear/Shiflett 吉他；体育场 alt-rock 核心编制。

note.en: Double-tracked vocal and open-chord drive as a Foos signature.
note.zh: 双轨人声与开放和弦推进，作为 Foos 标志曲。

note.en: Post-Nirvana guitar band that grew from demo origins into stadium-scale alt-rock.
note.zh: Nirvana 之后的吉他乐队，从 demo 起源长成体育场体量的 alt-rock。
